entities.name: Joseph M. Schmondiuk
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Joseph Michael Schmondiuk was a Ukrainian Catholic prelate who served as Archeparch of Philadelphia. He was the first Ukrainian Catholic bishop born in the United States.
